final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS yz, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM g WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(cnt) > 0), k AS (SELECT g.src, g.yz, g.cnt, g.cnt - a.avgcnt AS diff FROM g JOIN a ON a.avgcnt IS NOT NULL AND g.cnt > a.avgcnt) SELECT AVG(yz) AS avg_yz, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
